name: Gem of Anacondra
summary: In the Wailing Caverns, Lady Anacondra bears one of four dream gems held by the corrupted serpent leaders. The stones are bound to the nightmare spreading through the Barrens.

sections.title: A Corrupted Focus
sections.body:
When Naralex fell into deep slumber, he sought to bring water and life back to the arid Barrens. Then the Emerald Nightmare entered his thoughts and twisted his closest disciples. Lady Anacondra and her fellow conspirators left their old ways and became the Druids of the Fang. Their purpose was to restore the land, but it turned into a toxic delusion.

Lady Anacondra carries one of four dream gems held by these serpent leaders. The gem focuses their corrupted bond with the Emerald Dream and anchors the nightmare within the cave system.

sections.title: Cleansing the Vision
sections.body: Nara Wildmane and the Cenarion druids in Thunder Bluff suffer visions in their sleep. The wicked faces of the Fang's leaders haunt them. They claim the Gem of Anacondra and the stones of Cobrahn, Pythas, and Serpentis to confirm Lady Anacondra has been struck down. Gather all four, and the oppressive nightmare can lift from the minds of Kalimdor's keepers of balance.

faq.q: What is the Gem of Anacondra?
aliases: what does gem of anacondra do
faq.answer: Lady Anacondra carries the Gem of Anacondra in the Wailing Caverns. It is one of four dream gems held by the leaders of the corrupted Druids of the Fang.

aliases: where do i turn in anacondra gem
faq.answer: Nara Wildmane, a tauren druid on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, seeks this gem and the other three dream gems. She hopes to free her mind from nightmares and protect the Barrens.

faq.q: Where can the Gem of Anacondra be found?
faq.answer: Lady Anacondra carries the gem in the winding underground tunnels of the Wailing Caverns in the central Barrens.

faq.q: Why are the dream gems important?
faq.answer: The corrupted leaders of the Druids of the Fang hold the four gems. Gathering them confirms the ringleaders have been eliminated and breaks their hold over the Emerald Dream's corruption in the region.

angles.text: As a Cenarion druid, you have a solemn duty to strike down a sister who surrendered her mind and forms to the corrupting Emerald Nightmare.
As a tauren, you aid Nara Wildmane of Thunder Bluff by recovering the gem. Then the dark visions that plague the Shu'halo's sleep on the Elder Rise may lift.
